name: IIT Quest
source:
IIT Quest is a choice based visual novel game where the story changes with every decision. 

Time-warp to the past and stop World War III. Have fun with your friends and enemies, make tough choices to solve "impossible" problems, unlock branching paths and achieve multiple endings.
translation:
IIT Quest is a choice based visual novel game where the story changes with every decision. 

Time-warp to the past and stop World War III. Have fun with your friends and enemies, make tough choices to solve "impossible" problems, unlock branching paths and achieve multiple endings.
